steps: Identify the cause of the blindness mentioned: Vitamin 'A' deficiency.
Evaluate the options for their nutritional enhancements.
'Flavr Savr' tomato is modified for delayed ripening.
Canola is modified for oil quality.
Golden rice is genetically engineered to produce beta-carotene, a precursor to Vitamin A.
Bt-Brinjal is modified for insect resistance. Therefore, Golden rice prevents Vitamin A deficiency.
